notes: CREDITS.md only says 'ten tracks (title, story, fog, village, curse, cave, reveal, battle, melancholy, yomi), re-encoded to MP3' from the Ninja Adventure Asset Pack by Pixel-boy and AAA (CC0 1.0); the pack's original track titles are not recorded anywhere in the repo, so orig.title is null. Music is played by js/audio.js music(track) through an <audio> element ('audio/music/<name>.mp3'); scenes come from MUS(...) beats in js/story/*.js and js/story2/*.js plus the book title screens in js/books.js. The TRACKS map also lists ending, temple and dojo, but those files do not exist and nothing calls them. Working tree has uncommitted edits by another agent (js/audio.js and many js files modified) but no new or untracked audio files at the time of this survey; this spec is based on HEAD.
